text:
Nina Park: deploy-bot paused release candidate. Preflight: staging cache_ttl=120 vs prod cache_ttl=3600; staging KMS=alias/redwood-dev vs prod=alias/redwood-prod; staging image=redwood/ggml:canary-v3 vs prod=redwood/ggml:v2.2. Also MODEL_SCOPE secret differs. Can't promote until parity fixed.

deploy-bot: PRECHECK FAILED [CACHE_TTL_DELTA][KMS_ALIAS_MISMATCH][IMAGE_TAG_MISMATCH][SECRET_MODEL_SCOPE]. See /deploy/preflight/3777770000.

Tom Alvarez: we can't change prod KMS or MODEL_SCOPE for a canary. Option A: pin canary image to prod v2.2 and disable new flag; Option B: pause and align staging to prod. A is faster.

Priya Desai: agree A. I'll open a tiny manifest patch to pin image + flag off. We'll add follow-ups to normalize TTL and MODEL_SCOPE.

Omar Ruiz: ping infra: INF-5102 created to track KMS alias and MODEL_SCOPE normalization. Assign infra-team.

Nina Park: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/inference/pull/4199 -- patch will set image=redwood/ggml:v2.2 and feature_flag new-tokenizer=false for canary only.

Tom Alvarez: applying patch to canary: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/worker model=redwood/ggml:v2.2 --record`

deploy-bot: re-running checks... note: image hash v2.2=sha256:9f8e7d...; recommendation: run cache-warm job `jobs/cache-warm --model=v2.2 --concurrency=4` to avoid cold misses.

Priya Desai: started cache-warm job.

Omar Ruiz: infra confirmed routing fallback supports v2.2 for the canary pools.

deploy-bot: preflight PASSED. Canary promoted. promotion_id=prom-3777770000. Release unpaused.

Nina Park: adding changelog note: "Canary pinned to prod model v2.2 and feature flag disabled due to env-parity deltas; follow-up INF-5102 opened for KMS/secret/TTL alignment."

Tom Alvarez: thanks team. Scheduling a post-release task to bench v3-canary in a staging-only run once infra grants KMS path and we normalize TTLs.
